Ram Mandir donation theft case investigation continues with questioning

An investigation into alleged theft of donations at the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya is ongoing, with key figures like Champat Rai being questioned by police. The Special Investigation Team (SIT) has recommended implementing a Chief Executive Officer system for the temple, similar to other religious sites. The incident has sparked political reactions and calls for accountability.
